{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:05.176320Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:05.175996Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:07.089618Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:07.088704Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:07.092349Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:07.092013Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.943393Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.942718Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.948137Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.947743Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.959053Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.956476Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.961991Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.961738Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.992334Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.991692Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.984\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.983\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     930.8\n",
      "Date:                Mon, 05 Oct 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           3.63e-41\n",
      "Time:                        12:27:11   Log-Likelihood:                0.79636\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             6.407\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             14.06\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          5.0040      0.085     59.130      0.000       4.834       5.174\n",
      "x1             0.5020      0.013     38.464      0.000       0.476       0.528\n",
      "x2             0.4955      0.051      9.658      0.000       0.392       0.599\n",
      "x3            -0.0200      0.001    -17.442      0.000      -0.022      -0.018\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.594   Durbin-Watson:                   2.460\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.743   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.281\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.182   Prob(JB):                        0.869\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       3.052   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.995293Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:11.995043Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.006908Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.003976Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.50430797  4.98413763  5.424994    5.79987246  6.09151424  6.29524195\n",
      "  6.41972807  6.48557007  6.52190633  6.56162879  6.63597885  6.76941456\n",
      "  6.97559218  7.25512252  7.59547059  7.97301505  8.35692913  8.71424539\n",
      "  9.01527217  9.23847185  9.37399941  9.42531997  9.40863942  9.35024191\n",
      "  9.28217139  9.23696689  9.24231646  9.3165081   9.46542507  9.68157932\n",
      "  9.94534175 10.22816717 10.49728428 10.72107982 10.87429257 10.94216371\n",
      " 10.92286164 10.82778291 10.67967978 10.50892212 10.34850772 10.2286408\n",
      " 10.17176963 10.18889824 10.27777859 10.42327983 10.59987432 10.7758317\n",
      " 10.91843214 10.99934209]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.009141Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.008883Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.021140Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.020269Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.98710389 10.84393966 10.58928126 10.26741138  9.93662166  9.65494081\n",
      "  9.46592718  9.38800417  9.4099495   9.49364287]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.026100Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.025846Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.520804Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.520102Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7f08450541a0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.528842Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.525353Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.543833Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.543170Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.548708Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.548411Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.562932Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.562273Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           5.003991\n",
       "x1                  0.502006\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.495505\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.019987\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.567921Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.567605Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.582135Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T12:27:12.581305Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.987104\n",
       "1    10.843940\n",
       "2    10.589281\n",
       "3    10.267411\n",
       "4     9.936622\n",
       "5     9.654941\n",
       "6     9.465927\n",
       "7     9.388004\n",
       "8     9.409950\n",
       "9     9.493643\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
